claim: P8 (the SEM energy-closure step, the one candidate that could make the Jacobi constant exact by construction in motion law v2) is killed in a faithful float replica: the closure equation has no useful root - sign-definite in the step scale, lever-starved at pericenter and in the far field - solving 0.3-7% of steps while costing 5x and worsening the B13 flyby 2.4x.
k_walking_diagnostic: K walks to a steady offset ~6.9e-4 within ~10 steps (increments 1.4e-4 decaying to 3e-5) - bounded, state-function (memo section 1.7 class)
cost: 5 step-evaluations per step (secant, 3 iterations) vs 1.0 for plain v2 - over P7's 1.5x bar
commands: python3 v2sem.py scan                                     (~56 s, writes flyby_omega.txt)
python3 v2sem.py flyby -k 8 --periods 6 --sem kick --out fb_k8_kick.json  (~5 s)
python3 v2sem.py flyby -k 8 --periods 6 --sem step --out fb_k8_step.json  (~5 s)
python3 v2sem.py ensemble -k 6 --periods 150 --out ens_k6_base.json        (~2-3 min; seed 7, deterministic)
python3 v2sem.py ensemble -k 6 --periods 150 --sem kick --out ens_k6_kick.json (~3 min)
